HOW TO OPERATE THIS STATION

  1. Turn on speakers or headphones. Each card is a real 1-second hydrophone clip from VTUAD (32 kHz recording, played at 16 kHz).
  2. Press ▶ LISTEN on a vessel card to hear that ship. The 1 s clip loops a few times so you can actually catch the rumble. Keys 1 2 3 play cargo / tanker / ferry.
  3. Watch SONAR SWEEP (left). The beam scans the fan. When it crosses a contact, that ship flashes in its range zone: A 2–4 km, B 3–5 km, C 4–6 km.
  4. Read ACOUSTIC SIGNATURE ANALYSIS (center). Waveforms are CQT envelopes of the same clip. The bar is cosine vs a k=20 prototype of that MMSI. Status goes ANALYZING → IDENTIFIED.
  5. Press [ RUN CLASSIFIER ] (or Space) to load the next real clip for each ship, re-score, and play the three hydrophone recordings in order.
  6. Use EMBEDDING SPACE (right). Each dot is one real 1 s clip. Color = vessel MMSI, gray = background (MMSI 0). Click a cluster to lock CURRENT VESSEL.

AUDIO toggle mutes playback. ? opens this guide. This is a demo of open-set identification — the live score is CQT prototype cosine because the 128-d encoder weights are not shipped in the page.
